subject: Syncboard: bridge schedule proposal for Nebuco technical deep dive
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@nebuco.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@nebuco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Syncboard: bridge schedule proposal for Nebuco technical deep dive

Hi Alyssa / Tom —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking through Nebuco's ingestion pipeline and the latency targets you mentioned. Quick recap and a proposal to make scheduling the technical deep dive easier across your team in US/EU/APAC:

Recap (2 min)
- Primary use-case: low-latency contextual search + short-form generation at scale (10–50 qps).
- Security constraints: U.S. data residency, SSO/SAML, SOC2 evidence required.
- Technical stakeholders: Alyssa (infra), Tom (app integration), 2 engineers expected on the deep dive.

Next step: technical deep dive + sandbox access. We recommend 45 minutes (demo + integration Q&A). To avoid awkward one-time slots for different timezones, we suggest a "syncboard" rotating cadence: Redwood runs three repeating weekly slots (one per region) and rotates which slot is the "primary" for customer-facing bookings each week so Nebuco sees at least one workable time every two weeks. This keeps the same recurring invites but balances inconvenience across both teams.

Proposed slots (examples) — we can adapt to your team preferences:
- Week A: Mon 10:00 PT / (Mon 18:00 CET) / (Tue 09:00 SGT)
- Week B: Wed 11:00 PT / (Wed 19:00 CET) / (Thu 10:00 SGT)
- Week C: Fri 08:00 PT / (Fri 16:00 CET) / (Sat 09:00 SGT) — (light preference: avoid Sat if possible)

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf (high-level runbook) and proposed-syncboard.ics (one-click recurring invites). I can load these into a shared Drive or send individual invites once you confirm preferred timezone for the invites (we can send in your local time or as UTC).

If that approach works, next actions:
1) Tell me which weeks/days you prefer to avoid.
2) Pick 1–2 preferred slots from the three examples or suggest alternates.
3) We'll route invites through Marissa (CS) who will manage the recurring invites and sandbox request.

Thanks — I can be flexible on the first session next week.

Karthik Iyer
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199
Redwood Inference
Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf (PDF), proposed-syncboard.ics (calendar invite)

From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@nebuco.com>

Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@nebuco.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Syncboard: bridge schedule proposal for Nebuco technical deep dive

Thanks Karthik — helpful recap. Quick answers and constraints from our side:

- We prefer 45 minutes. Two engineers (Sam and Priya) will join, plus Tom on integration details.
- Avoid Fri/Sat sessions if possible (team off on Fridays in EU).
- For the first session we'd like a slot that hits late morning ET or early afternoon CET if that exists (Tom and Alyssa prefer overlapping business hours).

From your proposed examples, the Week B Wed 19:00 CET (11:00 PT) could work if we can shift to Wed 16:00 CET (11:00 ET).

Also: can you confirm sandbox access requirements? Do we need a corporate IP allowlist or a short-term service account? Tom — tagging you for any infra constraints.

Appreciate the option to rotate — curious how the calendar invites will look for recurring sessions. If you can send the recurring templates, we can vote internally.

— Alyssa
Alyssa Turner
Head of Infrastructure, Nebuco
alyssa.turner@nebuco.com

- Wed 2026-10-28 11:00 ET (08:00 PT / 16:00 CET) — 45m

CC'ing Marissa to kick off invites and the sandbox checklist. Vanessa — wanted you on this thread in case we need to propose a dedicated slot for your team in the committed pipeline.

Thanks — Marissa here (CS). Per Karthik, I set up a short poll so your team can pick preferred slots and we can lock the recurring invites. Please pick two preferred times from the three-week rotation so we can create the recurring pattern and share the calendar files.

Poll: https://doodle.com/poll/7y4g-syncboard-nebuco
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cSyncboardShared

Proposed rotation matrix (summary):
- Slot A: 11:00 ET / 08:00 PT / 16:00 CET — weekly
- Slot B: 14:00 ET / 11:00 PT / 19:00 CET — weekly
- Slot C: 09:00 ET / 06:00 PT / 14:00 CET — weekly (early US)

We will:
- Create three recurring invites (one per slot) labeled "Nebuco — Redwood technical deep dive (rotating)".
- Mark a primary slot each week and rotate the primary label to make acceptance burden predictable.
- Provision a temporary sandbox service account and send the checklist in a separate Drive doc once the slot is confirmed.

Attachments in Drive: syncboard-rotation-table.csv, recurring-invite-template.msg. Let us know if you want invites in CET/ET/SGT timezones — we typically send in the recipient's local time by default.

If I don't hear back by EOD Thursday we'll pick Wed 11:00 ET as the tentative first session and send invites.

Thanks,
